“呵呵！”

赵霸轻笑一声道：“到时候，你若是反悔了不愿意，怎么办？”

“我既然敢和你约架，就没打算过输！”

“我输了，自己断一条腿，赵霸，如果你要是输了呢？”李青山开口问道。

“小子，有点意思！”

“如果我赵霸要是输了，老子就不娶王春晓了。”

“哼！”

“走！”

赵霸大手一挥，转身离去，声音中满是威胁道：“李青山，明日你最好给我按时到场了。”

等到明日，断了李青山一条腿，那是他自己心甘情愿的事情，春晓也不能将事情怪在自己身上。

一个瘸子，春晓怎么可能还看得上？

至于自己输？

开什么玩笑，自己会输给一个被自己从小欺负的软蛋不成？

“赵霸！”

“明天我和我土乡的朋友肯定到场，到时候少废话，见面就直接上手，谁全部被放倒了，谁就输！”

李青山忍住内心笑意，开口道。

“青山啊，你怎么和赵霸那个二流子约架，他们人可多，你打得过吗？”

李铁匠从门外走了进来，脸上满是担忧道。

“我看啊，这事情得赶紧报告政府，让政府来管教赵霸才是。”李财也从外面走了进来，一脸担忧。

除了担忧李青山之外，李财还担忧自己两个儿子。

要是到时候，李青山喊着自家两个儿子一起去约架，能不去吗？

唉！！

自己可就这两个儿子啊！

“青山，不能去啊，赵霸那群人下手可是黑着呢，而且背后还有人嘞。”

李三奎，老娘，嫂子和王乃香等人，也都一脸担忧道。

“山哥，赵霸再厉害也就是一个脑袋，只要你上，我大壮就跟着你上！”

“山哥，我二壮也是！”

“青山，明天我一定到场。”

大壮，二壮和赵红旗相互对视一眼，眼神中流露出一抹坚定和信任。

他们不知道为什么会有这个想法。

"Haha!"

Zhao Ba chuckled and said, "What if you regret it and don't want to?"

"Since I dare to have a fight with you, I have no intention of losing!"

"If I lose, I will break one of my legs. Zhao Ba, what if you lose?" Li Qingshan asked.

"Boy, that's interesting!"

"If I, Zhao Ba, lose, I will not marry Wang Chunxiao."

"Hmph!"

"Let's go!"

Zhao Ba waved his hand, turned around and left, his voice full of threats: "Li Qingshan, you'd better arrive on time for me tomorrow."

Waiting until tomorrow to break Li Qingshan's leg is something he is willing to do, and Chunxiao cannot blame himself for it.

How could Chunxiao still like a cripple?

As for losing?

Are you kidding me? I will lose to a weakling who I have bullied since childhood.

"Zhao Ba!"

"Tomorrow my friends from the country and I will definitely be there. Let's stop talking nonsense and get started when we meet. Whoever gets knocked down will lose!"

Li Qingshan suppressed the laughter in his heart and said.

"Qingshan, why do you have a fight with that second-rate Zhao Ba? There are so many of them, can you beat them?"

Li Tiejiang walked in from the door, his face full of worry.

"I see, this matter needs to be reported to the government immediately so that the government can discipline Zhao Ba." Li Cai also walked in from the outside with a worried look on his face.

In addition to worrying about Li Qingshan, Li Cai is also worried about his two sons.

If when the time comes, Li Qingshan calls his two sons to have a fight together, can he not go?

well!!

I only have these two sons!

"Qingshan, you can't go. Zhao Ba and his group are doing it secretly, and there are people behind them."

Li Sankui, my mother, sister-in-law, Wang Naixiang and others also looked worried.

"Brother Shan, no matter how powerful Zhao Ba is, he only has one head. As long as you go up, I, Da Zhuang, will follow you up!"

"Brother Shan, so is my second brother!"

"Qingshan, I will definitely be there tomorrow."

Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi looked at each other, with a touch of firmness and trust in their eyes.

They don't know why they have this idea.
